fields.options: What happens when a salary slip breaks a rule. Block: the slip can't be submitted until it's fixed (the rest of the payroll run goes through). Warn: a warning on the Payroll Entry and the slip. Off: no check.

fields.description: Employment Act 2007, s.19(3): total deductions may not exceed two-thirds of the employee's wages. Counts every deduction and loan repayment against gross pay.
fields.label: Deductions Above Two-Thirds of Pay

fields.options: Income Tax Act s.12B: on a staff loan at a rate below KRA's market interest rate, the employer pays fringe benefit tax on the interest the employee didn't pay, with the PAYE return. Enter KRA's rate for each quarter as it is published. See the Fringe Benefit Tax report.

fields.description: The corporation tax rate (30% for resident companies).
fields.label: Fringe Benefit Tax Rate (%)

fields.options: Sent from a submitted Payroll Entry (Send Payslips by SMS) or one Salary Slip (Send by SMS), to the mobile number on each Employee, through the Bulk SMS app. Keep it short: 160 characters is one SMS. Anyone holding the phone can read it, so it's a summary, not the payslip.
